title: Booktok Event
seo_title: BookTok Night at Amelia's Chapter House in Joplin, MO
description: Amelia's Chapter House hosts a BookTok night for romance readers, fantasy fans and anyone with a full TBR. The $20 ticket includes $10 in book credit, one chance to play Book Plinko, 50% off used books and 10% off new books; tickets are required for entry and only 25 are available. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM at 5357 N Main St in Joplin, Missouri.
